Night notes from the city

Late in the evening the city changes. The streets are empty, the windows of the old houses are dark, and only a few cars drive slowly past the river. I like to walk home from work at this time, because the air is cool and nobody is in a hurry.

Near the bridge there is a small restaurant that stays open all night. The owner is an old friend of my father, and he always gives me a cup of tea and a piece of bread before I continue. We talk about the weather, about books, and about the strange people who visit his kitchen after midnight.
